episodes.title: Sally
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine have relocated their band, Flight of the Conchords, to New York.

episodes.title: Bret Gives Up The Dream
episodes.summary: Bret leaves the band to take a real job. Murray and Jemaine are forced to seek his replacement.

episodes.title: Mugged
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine's friendship is put to the test after they come face to face with some muggers.

episodes.title: Yoko
episodes.summary: Jemaine feels crowded by Bret's new girlfriend Coco and accuses her of being the band's Yoko.

episodes.title: Sally Returns
episodes.summary: When Sally shows up again, things get complicated with Jemaine, Bret and Coco.

episodes.title: Bowie
episodes.summary: Bret gets help with body issues from Jemaine, Mel and David Bowie (in a dream).

episodes.title: Drive By
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine fight a race war and Murray falls for the tech support woman.

episodes.title: Girlfriends
episodes.summary: Bret acts as Jemaine's 'wingman'and Murray makes a CD deal.

episodes.title: What Goes on Tour
episodes.summary: Murray dips into his bank account to finance a warm-up tour to prep for a big gig.

episodes.title: New Fans
episodes.summary: Murray urges the guys to make their image more 'rock 'n roll,' and they pick up some new fans.

episodes.title: The Actor
episodes.summary: To cheer up Murray, the guys enlist a semi-professional actor to pose as a record label guy.

episodes.title: The Third Conchord
episodes.summary: When Murray springs a new band member on the guys, it causes much disharmony.

episodes.title: A Good Opportunity
episodes.summary: Murray and the guys become sell-outs. For a few days, anyway.

episodes.title: New Cup
episodes.summary: Bret becomes a prostitute to pay off his reckless cup purchase.

episodes.title: The Tough Brets
episodes.summary: Bret starts a gang for his own protection.

episodes.title: Murray Takes It to the Next Level
episodes.summary: The guys become friends with Murray (for a while).

episodes.title: Unnatural Love
episodes.summary: Jemaine's Australian girlfriend ruins his life.

episodes.title: Love Is a Weapon of Choice
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine fall in love with the same girl.

episodes.title: Prime Minister
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine meet the prime minister of New Zealand.

episodes.title: New Zealand Town
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine become addicted to hair gel.

episodes.title: Wingmen
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine stage a mugging to impress a lady.

episodes.title: Evicted
episodes.summary: Bret and Jemaine get evicted and stage a musical to pay off their landlord.
